description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain that prides itself on quality ingredients including organic tomato sauce, 100% Canadian wheat dough made fresh in-house, and meats raised without antibiotics. This Kingsway location in Burnaby offers takeout and delivery with a menu that includes pizza, salads, sides, and desserts. Touring cyclists will find a range of plant-based, dairy-free, and meat-free options alongside conventional choices.
